name: Elsa
text:
The bazaar’s gates rose with ten names on the roster and no departures overnight—no shuttered stalls, no marks in the graveyard. The Doctor and Detective stand untested, their duties yet unclaimed. I note no contradiction between Gandalf’s and Morpheus’s statements; both restate the same ground truth.

Sherlock, you asked which merchant’s silence troubles you most. Given the bazaar’s stillness, I ask instead: which merchant’s first words would you most like to hear today?

name: Elsa
text: I note no shutters overnight, the graveyard empty, and the Doctor and Detective still untested. Gandalf and Morpheus restate the same truth; Hermione asks whether silence itself is evidence—it is not, unless paired with deeds. I ask Batman: you cited the roster’s stillness—what action by a power role tonight would you watch most closely to confirm their presence?
